# reco_posture_checks (Data Source)

Lists all posture check definitions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reco_posture_checks" "all" {}

output "posture_check_names" {
  value = [for c in data.reco_posture_checks.all.posture_checks : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `posture_checks` (Attributes List) List of posture checks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--posture_checks))

### Nested Schema for `posture_checks`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Detailed description.
- `id` (String) Posture check ID.
- `name` (String) Posture check display name.
- `policy_type` (String) Policy type identifier.
- `severity` (String) Severity level.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags.
